profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap-mapped point is attributed to QTS and reverse-geocodes to 3850 E McDowell Road, Camelback East, Phoenix, AZ 85008, an address whose Nominatim result identifies the location as "Harbor View Apartments." QTS's own current site lists its confirmed Phoenix-metro facilities as PHX1 (120 E Van Buren St, downtown Phoenix, tracked separately in this registry), PHX2, PHX3 (a 375-acre, 750MW campus in Glendale acquired by QTS in July 2022 for $255.3 million, per Data Center Dynamics' reporting), PHX4, and an Avondale facility; none of these published QTS locations correspond to a McDowell Road/Camelback East address. A targeted search for any QTS presence specifically tied to McDowell Road or Camelback East in Phoenix found no independent confirmation. Rather than assume this mapped point matches one of QTS's confirmed campuses or invent a match, this row states plainly that no QTS facility was found at the reverse-geocoded address; it may represent a mapping error, an outdated or since-closed QTS presence, or a genuinely distinct site not yet covered by QTS's current public materials.

reading.body:
QTS Phoenix 2 campus is published as an 80-acre, five-building facility with 210 MW or more of critical capacity. Assuming 40 kW per rack, a common density for AI training infrastructure, 210 MW of IT load would support roughly 5,250 racks. The campus total is not broken into per-building figures in published sources.

In Arizona, QTS Phoenix 2 ranks fifth among the four facilities with published megawatt figures, meaning it is the largest single campus with a public capacity claim in the state. Arizona has 56 mapped data center facilities total, of which only four have published power figures, together totaling 512 MW. QTS Phoenix 2 accounts for 41 percent of Arizona's published data center capacity by this measure.

No certifications, security ratings, cooling technologies, or grid connection details are published for this campus. The facility's specific building address could not be verified against QTS's known Arizona locations, and no information is available on power availability, water use, or current operational status.
